rush.title: Launch this week
rush.question: A support team needs a working help center within three working days.
rush.next_check: Test the hosted editor and mobile search with the support team.

lean.title: Lean startup
lean.question: A small team can spend at most $80 each month and has two weeks to launch.
lean.next_check: Measure CMS upgrade and backup work before treating maintenance as affordable.

build.title: Engineering ownership
build.question: An available engineer has five weeks; the team prefers low running cost and ownership.
build.next_check: Prototype preview publishing and include engineering labor in the budget.

care.title: Managed support
care.question: A support-led team prioritizes vendor assistance and has limited engineering time.
care.next_check: Ask for a written uptime commitment and test the stated support response window.

brand.title: Design control
brand.question: A design-led team needs full templates and source access within twelve working days.
brand.next_check: Check the search plugin's accessibility and test content export with images.

tight.title: Impossible constraints
tight.question: A team asks for a five-day launch with a $40 monthly ceiling; the engine must not invent a winner.
tight.next_check: Agree which constraint can change, then rerun the comparison with that approved limit.
